lead: # …and what the RELAY CLIENT needs, moved here with it. Copied verbatim from src-tauri's
# manifest so the two cannot resolve different feature sets: `tokio` runs the client,
# `tokio-tungstenite` dials the relay over real (CA-signed) TLS via rustls + webpki roots,
# `base64` mints the room id, `rand` the room id + PSK bytes.
# NOTE rustls is deliberately NOT a dependency here. rustls 0.23 will not auto-select a
# CryptoProvider, so the first TLS handshake panics unless one is installed as the process
# default — and that is the EMBEDDER's job, not the client's (src-tauri does it in lib.rs
# `run`). A second host must do the same before it dials.
# The mobile-tunnel wire contract + Noise IK crypto, extracted Tauri-free (#1919) so the byte-exact
# protocol (shared with mobile-studio-code) and the handshake live in one shareable crate — and,
# since `the-relay-client-moves-into-the-shared-tunnel-crate`, the relay CLIENT that speaks them.
# The desktop bus / Tauri commands / FCM push stay in src-tauri, which now depends on this crate
# for the client too and supplies the application half as a `relay::TunnelHost`.
sections.name: [dependencies]
